notes: CR 616.1: when two or more replacement effects would modify how an event affects a player, the affected player chooses one to apply, then the ones still applicable are checked again (616.1e-f). Seat 1 Shocks seat 0, who controls two Nine Lives ('If a source would deal damage to you, prevent that damage and put an incarnation counter on this enchantment'). Seat 0 is asked which applies and answers the second one: it prevents the damage and gets the counter; the first one then has nothing left to replace. Before the fix two matching damage replacements raised NotImplementedError (replacements.py, B-69), which voided the game.
